content: When spawning `agy` from Node, always close the child's stdin (`child.stdin.end()`) — agy reads stdin even for non-interactive subcommands like `models`, so leaving it open hangs the process until the abort timeout fires. A mocked-spawn unit test cannot catch this; live-validate agy integrations against the real CLI before trusting them.
context: T-019: runAgyModels spawned `agy models` without ending stdin and returned null on every real call — it blocked ~15s, hit the AbortController timeout, then fell back to the default model, silently turning gemini's latest-model discovery into a slow no-op. All unit tests passed (spawn was mocked). Caught only by running the real binary via a throwaway tsx script; fixed with child.stdin.end() and locked with a regression assertion. The review path (runAgyPrint) already closed stdin — runAgyModels had simply omitted it.
title: agy subprocesses block on stdin — close it even for `agy models`
